quarterly_data.signal: Primoris Q2 2026 results release: net loss $24.2 million ($0.45 per diluted share), adjusted net loss $14.6 million ($0.27 per share) and adjusted EBITDA $11.4 million, down 92.6% from $154.6 million; the release attributes the six renewables projects' cost overruns to project redesign, changes in project sequencing, labor productivity challenges, sub-surface issues and unfavorable weather, and the Energy revenue decline to slower starts of new projects, release of new work and slower financial close. For 2026 Primoris targets gross margins of 10% to 12% in Utilities and 6% to 8% in Energy, SG&A in the low 6% range of revenue and interest expense of $43 million to $47 million; liquidity at June 30, 2026 was approximately $958.9 million.
